source_review.notes: Checked current approved SLSA v1.2 source/build/provenance requirements, current OCI image specification, Reproducible Builds definitions, NIST SP 800-204D and SSDF 1.1, in-toto/TUF primary papers, Humble/Farley, Build Systems a la Carte, and current Sigstore documentation. Draft SLSA pages are not used as current normative requirements, and mechanisms are separated from security/correctness claims.

evidence: Checked source S, dependency graph D, toolchain/builder T, parameters P, context X, build B, artifact A and evidence E notation.
Checked artifact digest, invocation identity, release record, environment configuration and trusted-computing-base terms for distinct roles.
Checked reproducible, hermetic, repeatable, deterministic, immutable, promotion, release and deployment terms against stated definitions.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Digest equality is scoped to a specified algorithm/serialization or content graph and never treated as origin or authorization.

evidence: Recomputed canonical manifest ordering as linux-amd64|a.txt=alpha|b.txt=beta independent of insertion order.
Recomputed toy polynomial checksum 8a242f1a modulo 4294967291 for the declared manifest and verified alpha! changes it.
Checked multi-platform example distinguishes one index digest from separate amd64 and arm64 manifest subjects.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The executable checksum is explicitly non-cryptographic and excluded from real integrity/security use.

evidence: Traced build function from complete source/dependency/tool/parameter/context inputs to artifact and evidence outputs.
Checked build-once promotion invariant requires candidate, verified and promoted digests to agree plus evidence/policy validity.
Checked source revision alone and human tag alone do not identify output bytes.
Checked test, scan, SBOM, provenance, signature, reproducibility and approval as independent statement types bound to explicit subjects.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: No evidence type is allowed to imply another without an explicit verified relationship.

evidence: Reviewed dirty/untracked source, submodules, generators, floating dependencies, network/time/locale/path/random/parallel inputs, build scripts, base images and caches.
Reviewed unavailable checks, partial publication, mutable tags, wrong target/ABI, multi-platform evidence gaps, environment rebuilds, embedded secrets, rollback/data incompatibility and retention.
Reviewed untrusted pull-request cache poisoning, build-platform compromise, provenance self-reporting, signer authority/key policy and stale vulnerability evidence.
Reviewed cardiac-device and emergency-radio transfers with named clinical/public-safety, engineering, human-factors, security, operations, quality, regulatory and independent reviewers.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: High-consequence artifacts require product/domain and operational authorization beyond build-chain integrity.

evidence: Traced exact integrated revision, complete effective input graph, isolated invocation, final package identity and evidence binding.
Checked artifact/evidence publication precedes discoverable release mapping and retries remain idempotent.
Checked same digest is promoted rather than rebuilt and runtime inventory records deployed subject/configuration.
Checked secrets remain authorization/runtime inputs and do not leak into artifacts, provenance, logs or untrusted caches.
invariant_checking.notes: Every stage fails closed for missing, ambiguous, incompatible, expired, untrusted or unavailable required evidence.

evidence: Reviewed order-independence result as a consequence of sorted manifest paths under the toy definition.
Reviewed change-detection example for one changed string and explicitly rejected collision/security generalization.
Checked reproducibility and hermeticity counterexamples in both directions.
Confirmed no digest, signature, SBOM, scan, provenance, green pipeline or reproducible build is presented as proof of artifact correctness or deployment safety.
proof_review.notes: Formal claims remain about declared transformations and identities; trust and deployability require additional scoped evidence.

evidence: Audited uses of trusted, verified, secure, reproducible, hermetic, immutable, identical, deployable, safe and approved.
Separated content integrity, claimant authenticity/authority, provenance completeness/accuracy, artifact behavior and release authorization.
Confirmed current specification versions are date-qualified and external review is not claimed.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Potentially strong claims name the artifact digest, statement, actor, policy, tool, time, target and residual limitations.

evidence: artifacts/snippets/SDRE-001/report.json
Reproduced canonical manifest, toy checksum 8a242f1a, insertion-order independence and content-change detection under recorded Python 3.
Confirmed initial hashlib/json implementation was rejected by repository snippet policy and replaced with a safe dependency-free pedagogical model.
Confirmed cryptographic integrity, collision resistance, filesystem/package capture, provenance, trusted building and deployment are excluded.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Execution demonstrates canonical ordering and sensitivity only.

conceptual_review.notes: The chapter gives an end-to-end source-to-artifact transformation model with precise identities, trust boundaries and evidence while leaving locking, hermetic builds, repositories, versioning, SBOMs, signing, CI and release methods to later modules.

practitioner_review.notes: Production guidance covers dirty source, effective inputs, toolchains/generators, target contracts, build-once promotion, caches, artifact testing, atomic publication, provenance/signing distinctions, rollback and runtime traceability.

pedagogical_review.notes: Objectives align with ten distinct examples and five exercises progressing from trace construction and nondeterminism diagnosis through pipeline repair, format comparison and critical-firmware assurance transfer.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
